status: frozen before any new controlled quality score; no parameter search

scope.AR: new G-only directional-polynomial AR mechanism; identical independent same-colour bounded cubic fallback for R/B
scope.spectral: same independently derived geometry FIR as first study plus new local measured-range/noise limiter
scope.previous_study: read-only; spectral Python helper copied into independent file, not imported or modified
scope.RAW: none opened; no DNG exports; any future RAW work must use one independent process per source because of first-study S1H tail issue

input_contract.units: pre-normalized linear using each selected phase actual black and white
input_contract.measurements: hard float32 input representation restored exactly

noise_sigma.zero_semantics: no external noise variance; no automatic estimator
noise_sigma.positive_semantics: one declared calibration value for the acquisition setting, not a per-pixel truth oracle
noise_sigma.noiseaware_AR: used only if sigma>0; exactly equals reliable_AR for sigma0
noise_sigma.spectral_guard: used only if sigma>0 for missing-site noise reliability
noise_sigma.benchmark_agreement: new diagnostics use fixed reference18%-gray sigma=sqrt(shot*0.18+read^2) per acquisition noise setting; clean/old-regression/ablation sigma0
noise_sigma.theory_assumption: noise gain coefficients assume independent homoscedastic source samples; reference-gray sigma approximates heteroscedastic shot noise and reflection reuses samples near boundaries

common.output_clipping: no global clamp; declared same-colour local range only

g_ar_reliable.training: 24 selected G centers in radius3 square about missing site, with (dy+dx) odd
g_ar_reliable.model: base=(qH+qV)/2; d=qV-qH; r=measured_center-base; sum-one symmetric H/V mixture
g_ar_reliable.PRESS_proxy: unclipped-fit residual/(max(1-w*d^2/(sum(w*d^2)+lambda),0.05)); frozen local lambda and design-row deletion
g_ar_reliable.bound: min/max of 8 selected fine-scale H/V stencil samples
g_ar_reliable.PRESS_caveat: Overlapping source supports and data-dependent features mean this is a stabilized local reliability surrogate, not independent source-sample held-out validation.

g_ar_noiseaware.base: same predictive AR; sigma0 exactly same code path as reliable_AR
g_ar_noiseaware.direction_candidate: q=L+beta*K at both training and interpolation scales
g_ar_noiseaware.combination: multiply PRESS reliability by extra_reliability; never invert a noise-debiased near-zero covariance
g_ar_noiseaware.bound: same8 selected samples as reliable_AR; actual measurements never denoised

RB_AR_fallback.claim: common independent regular-grid bounded cubic fallback, no new R/B autoregressive method
RB_AR_fallback.stencil: separable[-1,9,9,-1]/16, 4 points on one missing axis or16 when both axes missing
RB_AR_fallback.bound: range of the actual selected4/16 stencil samples

spectral_local_guard.spatial_window: separable1 to radius32 then halfcosine to0 at48
spectral_local_guard.cardinality: observed-lattice offsets zero except center1; each CFA phase DC normalized after compact truncation
spectral_local_guard.execution: FFT valid convolution with parity-preserving reflection; finite97x97 FIR, never whole-frame FFT
spectral_local_guard.local_range: range of selected source sites in radius3 square for G or radius4 forR/B; project only missing spectral predictions
spectral_local_guard.low_SNR_pilot: G4-neighbour selected mean; R/B common bounded cubic
spectral_local_guard.limitation: Range guarantees remove step over/undershoot but also suppress legitimate extrema absent from measured local samples. Ringing that stays inside a nonconstant local range and aliasing may survive.

references.title: Li and Orchard, New Edge-Directed Interpolation (2001)
references.role: coarse/fine covariance geometric prior; not reproduced

references.title: Zhang and Wu, Edge-guided directional filtering and data fusion (2006)
references.role: directional prediction/statistical fusion inspiration; not reproduced

references.title: Allen, Variable selection, data augmentation and prediction (1974)
references.role: PRESS idea; only stabilized fixed-design row-deletion algebra is borrowed

references.title: Golub, Heath and Wahba, Generalized Cross-Validation (1979)
references.role: linear ridge hat-matrix prediction-error framework; no parameter search/GCV algorithm reproduction

references.title: Hyman, Accurate Monotonicity Preserving Cubic Interpolation (1983)
references.role: local shape/range preservation principle only; our two-dimensional range limiter is not Hyman algorithm

limitations: No recovery or uniqueness guarantee beyond the selected-colour sample lattice Nyquist region.
Coarse/fine direction invariance is a prior; periodic textures can have different coarse-scale aliases.
AR is H/V symmetric and can miss arbitrary oblique geometry, corners, and asymmetric fine structures.
Local ranges can clip legitimate unsampled extrema; hard observed noise/defects are preserved.
Known reference-gray calibration sigma is an approximation for signal-dependent shot noise, not an optimal per-pixel model.
PRESS proxy uses correlated, overlapping samples and is not a statistical validation certificate.
No test scores were observed and no tuning sweep/training was performed before freeze.
